comparisonPolicy.commonSupport: Common399、冻结 20 合同、同一字词与形码数据、CKT v4 模型及日常八场景文稿
comparisonPolicy.boundary: 无飞键道(U357)与S005按传统21×21合同计分；神韵(Overall-17)原生遵循飞花式四码顶；B04采用原资料记录的AEUIO形辅与IEUAO调辅，本比较为其套用同一飞花式四码顶路由和统一字形／笔画源。四者共用语料和模型，但不同键域与合同不是同键域胜负。

cktV4AuxiliarySources.Overall17: native key mapping with shared snowshape/stroke character data
cktV4AuxiliarySources.U357: native key mapping with shared snowshape/stroke character data
cktV4AuxiliarySources.S005: native key mapping with shared snowshape/stroke character data
cktV4AuxiliarySources.B04: documented AEUIO/IEUAO key mapping with shared snowshape/stroke character data

comparisonPolicy.groupPeakDefinition: 先在每个冻结合同内合计组内各键负载，再取 20 合同最大值
comparisonPolicy.eightTrackAggregation: 键道与三拼各含单字、二字、三字、四字轨；词长权重 1:3:1:1，两种模式等权

cktV5OrderSelection.Overall17: layout-specific minimum under the complete CKT v5 objective
cktV5OrderSelection.U357: layout-specific minimum under the complete CKT v5 objective
cktV5OrderSelection.B04: complete-policy lowest mean rank under the independent 0%-500% five-coefficient perturbation grid

contract.name: native-route-six-code
contract.word3Traditional21x21: three main plus three auxiliaries from distinct source positions
contract.word3Routing: traditional 21x21 uses AAA/AAAB/AAABB/AAABBB; four-code-top keeps AAA/AAAU/AAAUB/AAAUBB

flyingKeyComponents.scope: Common399 实际二键码；沿用 M-R2 的规范化书写韵尾，j/q/x/Y 后的 u 还原为 v
flyingKeyComponents.definition: 同一逻辑声母、零声母组或韵母分布在两个或更多物理键上时，该成分计 1；不同成分共用一个键、或成分整体移到非本位键均不计

terminalWordCollisionBuckets.definition: 二辅后仍有目标位次大于 1 的有效桶；每个残余条目按最佳终局编码归入一个桶

definition.afterZeroAux: 裸编码后仍未成为首选、需要第一辅键的频率权重
definition.afterOneAux: 第一辅键后仍未成为首选、需要第二辅键的频率权重
definition.afterTwoAux: 第二辅键后终局候选位次仍大于 1、需要人工选重的频率权重
